import CategoryTheory
import CategoryTheory.Functor
import CategoryTheory.LocallySmall
import CategoryTheory.ObjectProperty

open CategoryTheory

theorem lg_target {C : Type u} [CategoryTheory.Category.{v, u} C] [CategoryTheory.EssentiallySmall.{w, v, u} C] : CategoryTheory.HasSubobjectClassifier (CategoryTheory.Functor Cᵒᵖ (Type w)) := by
  let F := Functor Cᵒᵖ (Type w)
  
  -- Show that F is locally small
  have h_locally_small : LocallySmall.{w, v, u} F :=
    locallySmall_of_essentiallySmall (EssentiallySmall.of_unop (EssentiallySmall.of_functor _ _ _))
  
  -- Show that F is cartesian closed
  have h_cartesian_closed : CartesianClosed F :=
    Functor.CartesianClosed.of_small_domain (EssentiallySmall.of_unop (EssentiallySmall.of_functor _ _ _))
  
  -- Use the fact that cartesian closed and locally small implies has subobject classifier
  exact CartesianClosed.hasSubobjectClassifier h_cartesian_closed h_locally_small
